name: 折りたたんだグループ紹介

Image1 ORIGINAL is primary for grouped description surface, compact proportions, expansion-link semantics and fine details; Image2 Japanese mock secondary for exact localizedcopy, linebreaks and native typography; Image3 approved white/forestgreen style only.
